ipa.curves.zc_curve_definitions.Definition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curve_definitions.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    index_name: OptStr = None,
    main_constituent_asset_class: AssetClass | None = None,
    risk_type: RiskType | None = None,
    currency: OptStr = None,
    curve_tag: OptStr = None,
    id: OptStr = None,
    name: OptStr = None,
    source: OptStr = None,
    valuation_date: OptDateTime = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    market_data_location: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
index_name OptStr No None Example: "EURIBOR"
main_constituent_asset_class AssetClass | None No None See detail class AssetClass.
risk_type RiskType | None No None See detail RiskType class.
currency OptStr No None The currency code of the interest rate curve.
curve_tag OptStr No None User defined string to identify the curve. It can be used to link output results to the curve definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported.
id OptStr No None Id of the curve definition
name OptStr No None The name of the interest rate curve.
source OptStr No None Example: "Refinitiv"
valuation_date OptDateTime No None Example: "2019-08-21"
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters.
market_data_location OptStr No None The identifier of the market place from which constituents come from. Currently the following values are supported: 'onshore' and 'emea'. The list of values can be extended by a user when creating a curve.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

from lseg.data.content.ipa.curves import zc_curve_definitions
definition = zc_curve_definitions.Definition(source="Refinitiv")
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
